rationale: C05 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting framework for the child. Both are recent Trump orders addressing a PRC-linked economic threat through a transaction prohibition, followed in the same order by an authorization-or-license exception, identical anti-evasion and conspiracy provisions, definitions of person/entity/United States person, and delegated implementation authority with agency-wide assistance. Although much of this is standard IEEPA machinery, the combined sequence, close language, shared PRC predicate, and transaction-focused mechanism make C05 more than a merely topical analogue. C25 is nearly as strong but has slightly less overlap in its threat framing; C08 supplies similar Treasury-centered sanctions administration but is a broader and less closely matched sanctions order.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The following actions are prohibited: ... any transaction in publicly traded securities ... of any Communist Chinese military company ... by any United States person
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The following actions shall be prohibited beginning 45 days after the date of this order ... any transaction that is related to WeChat ... subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, with Tencent Holdings Ltd.
shared_material.explanation: Both use an opening transaction prohibition directed at economic dealings involving specified PRC-linked companies, with the target and effective-date mechanism adapted to securities and military-company listings.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The prohibitions in subsection (a) of this section apply except to the extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or licenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding any contract entered into or any license or permit granted before the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The prohibition in subsection (a) of this section applies except to the extent provided by statutes, or in regulations, orders, directives, or licenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwithstanding any contract entered into or any license or permit granted before the date of this order.
shared_material.explanation: This clause is essentially verbatim and occupies the same position immediately after the principal transaction prohibition.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Any transaction by a United States person or within the United States that evades or avoids, has the purpose of evading or avoiding, causes a violation of, or attempts to violate the prohibitions set forth in this order is prohibited. ... Any conspiracy formed to violate any of the prohibitions set forth in this order is prohibited.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Any transaction by a United States person or within the United States that evades or avoids, has the purpose of evading or avoiding, causes a violation of, or attempts to violate the prohibition set forth in this order is prohibited. ... Any conspiracy formed to violate any of the prohibitions set forth in this order is prohibited.
shared_material.explanation: The child reproduces the parent’s complete two-part anti-circumvention provision with only a singular/plural adjustment.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Secretary of the Treasury ... is hereby authorized to take such actions, including the promulgation of rules and regulations, and to employ all powers granted to the President by IEEPA ... The Secretary ... may ... redelegate ... All agencies shall take all appropriate measures within their authority
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Secretary is hereby authorized to take such actions, including adopting rules and regulations, and to employ all powers granted to me by IEEPA ... The Secretary may ... redelegate ... All departments and agencies of the United States shall take all appropriate measures within their authority
shared_material.explanation: The same implementation-and-redelegation machinery is retained while responsibility is shifted from Commerce to Treasury and consultation requirements are added.
